measurement_design.intervals: envelope of Student-t, session/input-stratified IID bootstrap, and within-session circular block bootstraps lengths 2 and 4; Bonferroni across 16 primary contrasts
measurement_design.control_guard: corrected lower gain bound must exceed the A/A 95% absolute interval envelope; both session point estimates must have the same favorable sign
measurement_design.outliers: retain all runs/hops; no post hoc removal or sample-size extension
measurement_design.limits: one high-frequency Ryzen physical core; unavoidable kernel/IRQ work monitored; not WCET or cross-platform proof
measurement_design.sem_note: iid_sem is a descriptive IID approximation for run means/counter repeats only; it is not used for effect inference and is deliberately omitted for serially dependent pooled calls.

isolation.limits: unavoidable per-CPU kernel activity/interrupts remain; no zero-kernel-work claim
